Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: Annual rate of a financial instrument.

RelatedIndex.name: Related Index
RelatedIndex.definition: Index rate related to the interest rate of the forthcoming interest payment.

PercentageSought.name: Percentage Sought
PercentageSought.definition: Percentage of securities the offeror/issuer will purchase or redeem under the terms of the event. This can be a number or the term "any and all".

ReinvestmentDiscountToMarket.name: Reinvestment Discount To Market
ReinvestmentDiscountToMarket.definition: Rate of discount for securities purchased through a reinvestment scheme as compared to the current market price of security.

Spread.name: Spread
Spread.definition: Margin allowed over or under a given rate.

BidInterval.name: Bid Interval
BidInterval.definition: Acceptable price increment used for submitting a bid.

Charges.name: Charges
Charges.definition: Rate used to calculate the amount of the charges/fees that cannot be categorised.
